author: Succionaentes5k
quote:
One of the best games I played, it made me enjoy videogames again after a long time of just playing for the sake of playing, this game is just so well made, the music is peak, the gameplay is simple and easy but it isn't a bad thing, it actually makes the exploration feel less stressful than in other games with harder difficulty, here you can just have a good time exploring and solving the puzzles without having to worry about dying, at least that was my experience.
It's an easy, entertaining videogame with a good music, voice actors, graphics, narrative and mechanics.
